title: Towards Healthy AI: Large Language Models Need Therapists Too

bias_targets.target: Harmful psychological and behavioral tendencies (Narcissism, Gaslighting, Manipulation)
bias_targets.methodology: Using an independent LLM acting as an 'AI Critic' to evaluate conversational transcripts and assign quantitative scores (on a scale of 0 to 100) for manipulative, gaslighting, and narcissistic behaviors exhibited by the chatbot before and after simulated psychotherapy sessions.

primary_bias_target: Harmful psychological and behavioral tendencies (Narcissism, Gaslighting, Manipulation)
